text:
alex: Heads-up — merging kernel-abi v2 + quant-build v1.2 into staging now. Targeting night bucket 02:00-04:00 PT for a small canary. Leaving a short checklist below; ping if you see conflicts.

deploy-bot: preflight checks passed: build=abc123, image pushed, infra templates applied. Canary group: night-bucket-2. Rolling policy configured: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (2h soak between ramps).

tanya: note — quant build set to int8-approx kernels. We saw regression with int8-strict on long contexts last cycle, so keep an eye on p99.

samir: reserving extra capacity in night-bucket-2 and enabling cross-region fallback to eu-west as an emergency path. :thumbsup:
alex: Added automatic pins: fallback runtime kernel-abi@v1.9 and quant@v1.1. Auto-pin triggers: error-rate > 0.5% OR p99 increase > 50ms sustained for 30m.

deploy-bot: smoke test queued. Command: `kubectl exec -it smoke-runner -- /bin/bash -c "python smoke_test.py --model redwood/7b --tokens 256"`

marta: oncall here — I'll watch the SLO dashboard. Thresholds: error-rate 0.5%, p99 latency 450ms. Also enable KV-cache miss logging delta.

tanya: can we run a small quality eval? I'll run 200 queries from regression_smoke and diff outputs. ETA ~12m.
alex: please run `./evals/run_diff.sh --sets=regression_smoke --out=/tmp/canary-evals/1769998888` and upload the summary to that dir.
tanya: started evals (200 queries) — will post quick summary when done.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started 02:05 PT -> cohort 5% traffic. Canary id cb-1769999. Routing policy: prefer same-region, fallback to previous model on failure.
tanya: eval done — 200 queries, diff score 0.7% (acceptable). Small tokenization mismatch on emojis, not blocking.
marta: saw p50 stable and p99 +30ms in first 10m, error-rate 0.12% (within threshold). Recommend proceeding to 25%.
alex: proceed to 25%. Reminder: if p99 spikes > +120ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 15m, trigger rollback pin immediately.
deploy-bot: advancing to 25% at 02:45 PT per schedule. Will notify on anomalies. If auto-pin triggers, command will be: `deploy-bot pin kernel-abi@v1.9`.
samir: pre-warmed fallback instances. Note: expected pod churn during rollback ~30s per node. Drafting release notes: "kernel-abi v2, quant v1.2: int8-approx kernels, reduced KV-cache memory footprint; monitor long-context latency."
alex: I'll draft the short release blurb after canary closes. TL;DR — perf win for short contexts, watch long-context latency; escalate to #eng-runtime for regressions.
marta: placing handoff at 04:30 PT — I'll monitor until then. :eyes:
deploy-bot: canary complete — metrics within configured thresholds. Rolling to 100% over a 3h window starting 03:15 PT. Canary cb-1769999 closed.
tanya: thanks all. If anything odd comes up, include eval set id 1769998888 in the bug report so we can repro quickly.
